title: 第四章 李雪的抱抱，舆论酝酿
slug: 华娱从继承视频网站开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

电梯声响，李雪抵达p站。

她就在隔壁海淀区租房，来一趟朝阳区也就半小时，挂了电话她就坐地铁过来了。

那么久没联系，第一句话居然是问她胖没胖，太不礼貌了！

虽然被苏行舟冒犯的语言刺激到了，但他还能开玩笑，就说明最近的风波压不倒他。

李雪放下心来。

“你好，我找一下你们苏总。”

李雪细长的手指在耳边比了个6，示意来之前预约过的。

前台看到笑颜如花的女孩，立马反应过来：

“是你啊，苏总吩咐过了，到了直接进他办公室就好。”

“哦好，谢谢~”

李雪意外对方还认得自己，她就一年前来试过一次戏。

前台女孩没解释。

笑起来这么好看，眼睛和月牙一样女孩，她怎么可能忘记。

咚咚咚！

“进！”

“苏总！”

李雪的语气硬邦邦的，表达自己还在为刚才的对话生气，可是甜美的笑容出卖了她。

“雪姐，好久不见！”

苏行舟起身迎她，想要给她一个拥抱，但是被李雪躲开了。

“别抱我，我怕我一身小肥肉挤到苏总。”

李雪侧开一个身位，可是她的月牙眼无论怎么看都不像生气的，吃了长相的亏。

“谁说的？谁说你有小肥肉？”苏行舟装模作样：“我帮你谴责他！”

“你！”李雪噗嗤一笑，没再故意板着个脸，对她的好脾气来说太难了：“我没胖，真的瘦了！”

她张开双手展示身材。

确实瘦了。

去年她巅峰体重都快120了，和苏行舟认识合作了微短剧之后，她就有了演员梦。

下定决心减肥，现在已经92斤了，丰腴正合适的程度。

下颌线瘦出来的李雪已经是后世大家印象中的那个美女。

不染不烫的黑色披肩直发，只涂了隔离薄粉底，一点点唇膏，皮肤胶原蛋白满满，白里透亮。

她日常穿搭比较休闲，浅色系的t恤，浅色牛仔裤，白色帆布鞋，风格清新干净，刚毕业不到一年的她看起来青涩又美丽。

“开个小玩笑，坐吧，我给你泡茶。”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The elevator sounded and Li Xue arrived at station p.

She rented a house in Haidian District next door, and it only took half an hour to come to Chaoyang District. After hanging up the phone, she took the subway over.

After not contacting her for so long, the first thing she said was to ask her if she was fat. It was so rude!

Although he was irritated by Su Xingzhou's offensive language, he could still joke, which showed that the recent turmoil could not overwhelm him.

Li Xue felt relieved.

"Hello, I'm looking for you, Mr. Su."

Li Xue made a 6 with her slender fingers in her ear, indicating that she had made an appointment before.

When I saw the smiling girl at the front desk, I immediately reacted:

"It's you. Mr. Su has given instructions. Just go into his office when you arrive."

"Oh okay, thank you~"

Li Xue was surprised that the other party still recognized her. She had come to audition once a year ago.

The girl at the front desk didn't explain.

How could she forget a girl with such a beautiful smile and eyes like crescent moons.

Boom, boom, boom!

"Come in!"

"Mr. Su!"

Li Xue's tone was firm, expressing that she was still angry about the conversation just now, but her sweet smile betrayed her.

"Sister Xue, long time no see!"

Su Xingzhou stood up to greet her and wanted to give her a hug, but Li Xue dodged him.

"Don't hug me, I'm afraid that my fat body will squeeze Mr. Su."

Li Xue turned to the side, but her crescent moon eyes didn't look angry no matter how she looked, which was the fault of her appearance.

"Who said that? Who said you have a little fat belly?" Su Xingzhou pretended, "I'll help you condemn him!"

"You!" Li Xue chuckled and stopped keeping a straight face. It was too difficult for her good temper: "I'm not fat, I've really lost weight!"

She spread her hands to show off her figure.

Really lost weight.

Last year, her peak weight was almost 120. After meeting and cooperating with Su Xingzhou in a micro-short play, she dreamed of becoming an actress.

I made up my mind to lose weight, and now I weigh 92 pounds, which is just the right level of plumpness.

Li Xue, whose jawline has slimmed down, is already the beauty that everyone remembers in future generations.

She has straight black shawl hair that is neither dyed nor permed. She only wears thin foundation and a little lipstick. Her skin is full of collagen and white and translucent.

Her daily outfit is more casual, wearing light-colored T-shirts, light-colored jeans, and white canvas shoes. Her style is fresh and clean. She has just graduated less than a year ago and looks young and beautiful.

"Just kidding, sit down and I'll make you tea."
